name: animator
short: A2A pixel-art rendering agent backed by pixel-art-mcp.
description: An A2A-only agent that models and renders pixel-art sprites and animations via the pixel-art-mcp server, and delivers the resulting Discord-ready assets (pixel-agents.zip, preview.png) as real attachments.
